discrepancy_analysis: h-main CONFIRMED: achieves score 100 (7/7 post-warmup runs). h-control-negative REFUTED: BnB-only also achieves 100 (5/5 runs), contradicting the prediction of ~99.345. The iter-1 baseline of 99.345 was caused by system-load-induced timeout variance, not a fundamental algorithmic limitation. Both solutions are algorithmically sufficient for score 100 on this test distribution.
